UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a Frutiger Chat user profile with custom MSN-style signature, current activity, presence status, and E2EE public key fingerprint.

userId.description: The authenticated user UID matching request.auth.uid.

username.description: Display username in Frutiger Chat (2 to 40 chars).

signature.description: Custom personal status signature text (0 to 160 chars).

currentActivity.description: Current activity or music/game status text (0 to 120 chars).

publicKeyFingerprint.description: Hexadecimal E2EE identity key fingerprint (8 to 128 chars).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FriendContact.title: FriendContact
FriendContact.description: Represents a buddy in the user's Frutiger Chat friends list.

friendUid.description: Unique identifier for the friend contact.

friendSignature.description: Friend custom signature text (0 to 160 chars).

friendActivity.description: Friend current activity text (0 to 120 chars).

ChatRoom.title: ChatRoom
ChatRoom.description: Represents a direct message or group chat conversation with E2EE metadata and participant list.

participantUids.description: List of participant user UIDs who are members of this chat room (1 to 20 users).

title.description: Display title of the direct message or group chat (1 to 60 chars).

isGroup.description: True if this conversation is a multi-user group chat.

avatarColor.description: Glossy buddy icon theme for the chat.

presenceStatus.description: Presence dot status for the conversation.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview text of the most recent message (0 to 300 chars).

lastMessageSender.description: Sender name of the most recent message (0 to 60 chars).

encryptionKeyId.description: Identifier/salt for the conversation AES-256-GCM key (4 to 128 chars).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents an end-to-end encrypted message inside a ChatRoom.

chatId.description: Parent chat ID matching the path {chatId}.

participantUids.description: List of participant UIDs allowed to read and receive this message.

senderId.description: UID or identifier of the sender (1 to 128 chars).

senderName.description: Display name of the sender (1 to 60 chars).

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted Base64 payload (1 to 4096 chars).

iv.description: Base64 initialization vector for AES-256-GCM (8 to 128 chars).

signatureHash.description: SHA-256 integrity hash of the message (8 to 128 chars).

messageType.description: Type of message or Frutiger Aero interactive effect.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user Frutiger Chat profile, custom signature, activity, and E2EE public key fingerprint.

/friends/{friendDocId}.description: Stores buddy contacts scoped by userId.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Stores direct message and group chat conversations with multi-device participantUids.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores E2EE encrypted messages inside a conversation accessible to all participantUids.
